decisions.id: W106-c3 the bath's tub is not judged by a door
decisions.summary: DOORLESS_KINDS = {bath}: a tub any of whose hosts is a bath is skipped
decisions.why: For the bath's own tub: 0105 draws the bath as a room or small addition of the residence, and measured, no bath on any sheet draws an outside door (doors_of empty on Ochiba's, Ubame's and the drafts'), so its entrance seat is physically absent; round 1's condition is met and it is now its own decision in spec.md, docs/buildings.md and 0100's drawing page. No live sheet passes that way now. Tighten it in the same fix round (exempt only when the bath is the nearest host, or equivalent) with that case as the test.

decisions.id: W106-ubame-shrine Ubame's shrine entrance drawn on its side, beside its corner tub
decisions.summary: Ubame's Inari shrine door drawn on its west face (946, 252-264), toward the grove; its tub left at (940,280)
decisions.why: Not labeled by the plan; found by checking each new door. The shrine (x 946-1020, y 232-284) has its approach torii (x 962-1004, y 300-312) due south on its own axis (x 983), so by the plan's own rule its entrance is the south face. Instead the door went on the west face, toward the grove trees, and the tub did not move: it stands 4 px above the SW eaves corner, 2.4 ft from it - the 'wall or eaves corner' seat the ranked fix says the tub must leave, now passing because a door was fitted to it. Round 1's c2 defect surviving by a word-level pass. Not impossible: the 16 px between the shrine's south face and the torii leaves room for a tub beside a south door. Remedy: draw the door on the south face toward the torii, move the tub beside it, re-run pack-audit. Aside (not a finding): Ubame's tally office tub (952,646) also stayed at its SW corner with its door drawn at the west end of the south face; the south ground is a yard, so the rule holds, but look at it in the same edit.
